tagline: Transform photos, swap faces, and make clean coloring pages.
shortDescription: Pixform offers image-to-image styling, single and multiple face swap, photo-to-coloring-page conversion, and manual text removal on simple backgrounds. Get 10 one-time free credits with Google sign-in.
longDescription: Pixform is a browser-based toolkit for editing photos you have permission to use. Transform a photo into a new visual style, swap one face, or replace up to five selected faces in a group photo using the same reference face. Turn a photo into clean black-and-white coloring outlines, or brush over unwanted text on a simple background. New accounts receive 10 one-time free credits with Google sign-in. Image to Image and Remove Text From Image use 1 credit per result; AI Face Swap and Photo to Coloring Page use 2; Multiple Face Swap uses 2 per selected face. Pro starts at $9 per month for 300 credits, with one-time packs from $9.
